props.innerMarkup:
<title id="aurora-title">Three coloured orbits turning around the Claude mark</title>
    <desc id="aurora-desc">A violet and pink halo breathes behind a still ring, while a magenta, a cyan and a lime arc each circle the mark at a different speed, carrying a glowing spark.</desc>
    <defs>
      <radialGradient id="aurora-halo-grad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-halo-soft)"></stop>
        <stop offset="55%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-halo-warm)"></stop>
        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-halo-warm); stop-opacity:0"></stop>
      </radialGradient>
      <linearGradient id="aurora-arc-main" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-magenta); stop-opacity:0"></stop>
        <stop offset="45%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-magenta)"></stop>
        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-amber)"></stop>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="aurora-arc-inner" x1="100%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-cyan); stop-opacity:0"></stop>
        <stop offset="50%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-cyan)"></stop>
        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-violet)"></stop>
      </linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="aurora-arc-outer" x1="0%" y1="100%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
        <stop offset="0%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-lime); stop-opacity:0"></stop>
        <stop offset="60%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-lime)"></stop>
        <stop offset="100%" style="stop-color:var(--aurora-spark-cyan)"></stop>
      </linearGradient>
      <filter id="aurora-glow" x="-120%" y="-120%" width="340%" height="340%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.5" result="aurora-blur"></feGaussianBlur>
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="aurora-blur"></feMergeNode>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"></feMergeNode>
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <g data-aurora="halo" style="transform-origin:178px 104px;">
      <circle cx="178" cy="104" r="100" fill="url(#aurora-halo-grad)"></circle>
    </g>

    <circle data-aurora="track" cx="178" cy="104" r="84" fill="none" style="stroke:var(--aurora-track); stroke-width:var(--aurora-ring-width); r:var(--aurora-ring-radius);"></circle>

    <g data-aurora="orbit-outer" style="transform-origin:178px 104px;">
      <circle cx="178" cy="104" r="92" fill="none" stroke="url(#aurora-arc-outer)" stroke-dasharray="26 552" stroke-linecap="round" style="stroke-width:var(--aurora-ring-width);"></circle>
      <circle cx="178" cy="12" r="3" filter="url(#aurora-glow)" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-lime);"></circle>
    </g>

    <g data-aurora="orbit-main" style="transform-origin:178px 104px;">
      <circle cx="178" cy="104" r="84" fill="none" stroke="url(#aurora-arc-main)" stroke-dasharray="132 396" stroke-linecap="round" style="stroke-width:var(--aurora-ring-width); r:var(--aurora-ring-radius);"></circle>
      <circle cx="178" cy="20" r="5" filter="url(#aurora-glow)" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-magenta); r:var(--aurora-spark-size);"></circle>
    </g>

    <g data-aurora="orbit-inner" style="transform-origin:178px 104px;">
      <circle cx="178" cy="104" r="70" fill="none" stroke="url(#aurora-arc-inner)" stroke-dasharray="70 370" stroke-linecap="round" style="stroke-width:var(--aurora-ring-width);"></circle>
      <circle cx="178" cy="34" r="4" filter="url(#aurora-glow)" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-cyan);"></circle>
    </g>

    <g data-aurora="motes">
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="56" cy="44" r="2.5" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-amber);"></circle>
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="300" cy="56" r="2" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-cyan);"></circle>
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="40" cy="160" r="2" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-violet);"></circle>
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="316" cy="150" r="2.5" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-magenta);"></circle>
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="122" cy="22" r="1.5" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-lime);"></circle>
      <circle data-aurora="mote" cx="236" cy="186" r="2" style="fill:var(--aurora-spark-amber);"></circle>
    </g>
